title: pm-dispatch: one concurrency cap for ALL subagents a seat has in flight (dev, reviewer, census — read-only included), and triage backlog prepared one batch at a time
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-assigned task. Director seat, summon #29 (`session_01EcrTi7s5oDYPHS4Pi7h31d`). Maintainer verbatim, in this seat's chat, 2026-09-25: 「不要同时派发这么多」 · 「小心封号」 · 「你为什么会犯这样的错误，技能写的不明显吗？」 · 「同意，让 skills 车道立卡补上这条规则」. Reader: the `domain:skills` seat, landing a Tier S edit under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`.

## What happened (this seat's own miss, recorded as the reason, ⛔ not as the card)
Asked to triage the cloud board in confirmed batches of ten, this seat launched **8 read-only reviewer subagents at once** (one per batch), alongside 1 dev: 9 in flight, all reading the GitHub API under the same identity. The maintainer stopped it. The rule the seat read did not stop it:
- `SKILL.md:59`: `batch`, the in-flight **dev** cap, default 3, ceiling 5. It names devs, so a seat can tell itself that reviewers "do not count".
- The ban warnings (`references/filing-gate.md:8`, "os-sam was banned during triage batch processing", and the write-pace lines) are phrased around **writes**, so a seat can tell itself that read-only is safe.
- "The stock clean-up still goes by maintainer-confirmed groups of ten" says how the seat **confirms**, not how much it **prepares** in advance.

## Deliverable (text only, Tier S)
1. **One cap for everything in flight.** The `batch` ceiling counts **every** subagent the seat has in flight: dev, reviewer, census or any other kind, read-only or not (default 3, ceiling 5). ⛔ "Read-only" is never a reason to exceed it. Reads under one identity are the load that preceded the os-sam ban.
2. **Triage backlog: one batch at a time.** For a maintainer-confirmed clean-up in groups of N, the seat prepares only the **next** group, and starts preparing the one after only once the current group is confirmed. ⛔ No fanning out every batch in advance "to save waiting".
3. Put rule 1 where a seat reads it before any `Agent` call (the `SKILL.md` Tunables row for `batch` and `references/execution-duties.md:21`), and rule 2 beside the groups-of-ten line in `references/filing-gate.md`. Wording is the lane's; keep each line to the repo's one-line rule style.
4. If a mechanical guard is cheap (for example, a dispatch-gates count of live subagents), note it as a follow-up in the PR body. ⛔ It is not required by this card.
